# The Anderson-DuBose Company

The Anderson-DuBose Company is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. The Anderson-DuBose Company employs 168 people (+19.1% YoY, +27 people), founded in 1991. Headquartered in Lordstown, Ohio, United States, with offices in Jefferson City, Rochester, Jacksonville, and Warren.

## About

The Anderson-DuBose Company is dedicated to being a leader in the distribution industry by providing world-class service and brand protection to our valued business partners. Our esteemed associates are committed to operational excellence, continuous improvement, environmental sustainability, respect for each other, community engagement, and ethical conduct while fostering a culture of employee appreciation.

The Anderson-DuBose Company provides logistics solutions and unparalleled service to the world's most elite corporations in the quick service industry. We are proud to be an integral part of the greatest supply chain in the world. Our talented and dedicated team is committed to excellence, quality, and customer satisfaction at every stage of the distribution process. The Anderson-DuBose name represents quality to our customers, our vendors, and our community.

# Alexander Dubose & Jefferson LLP

Alexander Dubose & Jefferson LLP is a Law Practice company. Alexander Dubose & Jefferson LLP employs 32 people and has an annual revenue of $6.9M, founded in 2003. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, United States, with offices in San Antonio, Houston, and Dallas.

## About

Alexander Dubose & Jefferson is an internationally-recognized appellate boutique with offices in Austin, Dallas and Houston. We've gathered highly-experienced, successful appellate practitioners from across Texas and assembled them into one firm devoted exclusively to the practice of appellate law.
